title: Quenched Arabian Pudding Delight
description: Indulge in a rich, creamy pudding dessert infused with exotic flavors of the Arabian region. A perfect treat after a warm meal.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the quenched and pudding mix.
Add the arabian spice blend and whisk until combined.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the melted butter and bitter cocoa powder.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional arabian spice blend if desired.
